title: From operational occurrence to the unique least Fold generator
description:
Fold is the unique least generator among every finite word in the normalized parameter-free primitive grammar.

Maria Smith derives the full chain from operational occurrence and structural One to exact finite count, positive part coordinates, common-refinement equivalence, the unique first Fold extension, complete finite word assembly, half-One and exact dynamics. Every image has exactly two Fold preimages; the one-third/two-thirds orbit gives nonstatic recurrence. Identity and square are injective; constant One has only static return. Fold alone generates at primitive size one, and every longer composition is nonminimal.

The paper supplies all intermediate constructions, quantified carriers, base and successor proofs, complete grammar classifications and all-word uniqueness. The 84-word executed primitive prefix sits within the general theorem over arbitrary finite words. Eleven source entries contain 2,182 candidate records and 44 original controls, with 1,311 exported native declarations carrying empty-axiom audits.

Includes full mathematical exposition, pinned original V3 source, native Lean proof bodies, source correspondence, retained build and comparison evidence, and portable exact reproduction. Scientific author: Maria Smith, Ernos Labs.

V3 foundation: 10.5281/zenodo.21627656. V3 monograph: 10.5281/zenodo.21900790. V4: 10.5281/zenodo.24320778.
